info.title: Backwork Coverage Policy API
info.description:
The Backwork API provides programmatic access to Medicare and commercial payer coverage policies,
medical code lookups, prior authorization requirements, and policy change tracking.

## Authentication
All endpoints (except /health) require an API key passed in the Authorization header:
```
Authorization: Bearer bwk_live_xxxxx
```

## Pricing and Rate Limiting
| Pack | Price | Requests | Requests per minute | Includes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Credits | $20.00 once | 1,000 requests, never expire | 60 | no overage: calls stop at zero |
| Build | $200.00 per month | 100,000 requests per month | 300 | overage billed per request |
| Scale | $1,000.00 per month | 1,000,000 requests per month | 1,000 | overage billed per request, webhooks for `compliance.acknowledged` events, [published SLA](https://backworkhealth.com/docs/sla) |

Every organization starts with 100 free starter credits, granted once; they never expire. Every API key in an organization draws on one balance of request credits and one sliding one-minute rate-limit window. A monthly allowance is spent before purchased Credits, and purchased Credits never expire. On Build and Scale, requests past the allowance bill as overage at $0.002 per request. With only Credits, a call the balance cannot cover returns `402 BILLING_CREDITS_EXHAUSTED`. Some endpoints count as more than one request, for both credits and the rate limit; the rest count as one. See https://backworkhealth.com/docs/rate-limits for the request cost of each endpoint.

Rate limit headers are included in all responses:
- `X-RateLimit-Limit`: Maximum requests per window
- `X-RateLimit-Remaining`: Requests remaining in current window
- `X-RateLimit-Reset`: Unix timestamp when window resets

## Response Format
All responses follow a consistent structure:
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": { ... },
  "meta": {
    "request_id": "req_xxxxx",
    "timestamp": "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z"
  }
}
```

## Error Handling
Errors include machine-readable codes for programmatic handling:
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "RESOURCE_POLICY_NOT_FOUND",
    "message": "Policy not found",
    "docUrl": "https://backworkhealth.com/docs/errors#resource-policy-not-found",
    "retryable": false
  },
  "meta": { "request_id": "req_xxxxx", "timestamp": "..." }
}
```
Retry only when `retryable` is true.

## Production Availability
Operations marked `x-backwork-availability: unavailable-in-production` are not live yet. Production
requests to them return 404 with `COMMERCIAL_SURFACE_UNAVAILABLE`.

## Sandbox
A synthetic-data sandbox at `https://backworkhealth.com/api/sandbox/v1` mirrors the policy search, code lookup,
prior-auth check, and coverage evaluation operations with the same request and response shapes. It needs a
`bwk_test_` key, which `POST /api/sandbox/v1/keys` issues without an account. Test keys work only on the
sandbox, and the sandbox rejects live keys. Its spec is at `https://backworkhealth.com/api/sandbox/v1/openapi.json`.

get.summary: List decisions from a certified release
get.description: Returns only the immutable `derived_decision_v1` allowlist from one `certified_release.v1` snapshot. This surface requires a dedicated API key whose complete scope set is exactly `certified:derived_decision:read`; OAuth credentials, ordinary `read` or `admin` keys, and keys carrying any additional scope are not valid for this endpoint. The key must also hold an active entitlement to the requested release. Responses are JSON only: omit `format` and `_format`, and omit `Accept` or request `application/json` (a wildcard Accept header is also treated as JSON). CSV or FHIR negotiation returns 406. Missing, expired, revoked, schema-incompatible, and unentitled releases intentionally share the same non-enumerating 404 response, sent with `Cache-Control: private, no-store`. An authorized query with no matching decision returns 200 with an empty data array.

post.description: Evaluate whether procedures require prior authorization based on procedure codes, payer, and state. Without `payer` (or with `payer: Medicare`) it answers for traditional Medicare from LCD/NCD policies in the state's MAC jurisdiction; with a payer it answers from that payer's policies. Returns matched policies, coverage disposition, documentation requirements, and clinical criteria. Codes a policy carries only because its title names the drug come back with `source: inferred_title_match`, cap the confidence, and are named in `known_gaps`. Send `X-Idempotency-Key` to replay the first response for safe retries.

post.description: Scores a claim payload against five denial-risk gaps (medical necessity, coding support, prior authorization, documentation completeness, and frequency limits) using one batched TypeSafe AI (Jev) call. Per-risk probabilities are combined in code into an overall risk level and a recommended action. Approved or not-required prior authorization clears that risk; other statuses are assessed against the supplied criteria. Returns 503 (SERVER_UNAVAILABLE) when TypeSafe is not configured and approved for sensitive data, and 400 (PHI_NOT_ALLOWED) when clinical documentation or criteria text contains patient identifiers. Requires prior authorization checker access.

post.description: Invokes one high-level Backwork tool through the controlled agent access layer. Use `GET /agent/tools` first to fetch the exact input schema for each tool. Read tools accept `read`, `admin`, `agent:tool:*`, or the tool-specific `agent:tool:<tool_id>` scope; write tools require `write`, `admin`, `agent:tool:*`, or the tool-specific scope. A key that holds any `agent:tool:` scope is limited to its agent scopes. `acknowledge_policy_change` also requires a plan with compliance dashboard access. Requests containing patient-identifying field names are rejected with `PHI_NOT_ALLOWED`.

parameters.description: Agent tool ID

parameters.name: X-Backwork-Agent
parameters.description: Optional agent name recorded in the invocation ledger. Must not contain PHI.

parameters.name: X-Backwork-Approval
parameters.description: Set to `reviewed` only after authorized review for tools that return approval_required=true.

schema.description: Tool-specific input. Fetch /agent/tools for the exact JSON schema for each tool.

data.description: Tool-specific result payload. Its JSON Schema is the tool's `output_schema` in GET /agent/tools; every result includes a `provenance` block.

202.description: Approval is required before the write tool executes
